name: research
description: Research-workflow skills for the Chronicle platform — the workflow layer over the chronicle plugin's mechanics, driven by your own agent with you as the approval gate. Four multi-step practices: synthesis (ground in the experiment record + literature, then propose and queue what to try next — pre-registered hypotheses required, nothing queued without your acceptance), evaluate-results (judge runs and variations against their pre-registered hypotheses; reading-only is first-class, optionally persist findings, lessons, and review-gated reports), literature-review (survey the internal corpus + external literature, register and cite what matters), and paper-authoring (author a LaTeX paper locally from the experiment record and attach it so Chronicle compiles and records it). Requires the chronicle plugin (skills + bundled MCP server) from the same marketplace.
